9.critic_justification: Verified that audio recording is user-initiated via the 'speak' command, captured by AudioRecord in WearableStreamingService, and transferred off-device via MaveSessionManager.

10.critic_justification: Crashlytics collection is explicitly disabled by default via 'firebase_crashlytics_collection_enabled' metadata in AndroidManifest.xml. It is only enabled programmatically after the user explicitly accepts the privacy policy in MainViewModel.acceptPrivacyPolicy(). The gatekeeper is valid and no silent background transfer occurs beforehand.

16.critic_justification: Verified that the registration flow collects gender via regGender in MainViewModel and transfers it to the backend via ApiClient.saveProfile. Since it is user-initiated, it is exempt from prominent disclosure but must still be declared.
